# AI-Powered Writing Assistant Chrome Extension

This project is a Chrome extension that provides AI-powered writing assistance using Ollama LLaMA 3.2 API.

## Project Structure
- Uses Manifest V3 for Chrome extension
- Modular TypeScript architecture
- Real-time writing suggestions
- Popup UI with TailwindCSS
- Options page for customization
- Background service worker
- Content scripts for text monitoring

## Development Guidelines
- Follow Chrome extension best practices
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Implement proper error handling and fallbacks
- Optimize for performance with debouncing and caching
- Ensure privacy and security compliance
